\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}

Attention mechanisms is very useful for the sequence modeling task, as prior
work \citep{vaswani2017attention} has showed, with a cost of $O(n^2)$ in the
sequence length (see also Section~\ref{sec:intro}).

They has been adopted widely across many domains of machine learning.
